notes.title: Patch 2.1.0.0 Live
notes.content:
Greetings Dungeoneers,

We hope you are enjoying your time in the league! We have just pushed our first post release patch with a a couple of new things and various fixes.

A reminder that if you want organise matches, chat strategies or simply be involved in the community we have an active Discord over at 

https://discord.gg/k5vGxwD


Grotesquely,
Dungeon Master


[b]Patch Notes 2.1.0.0[/b]

New
[list]
[*] Daily dungeon wins leaderboard added
[*] Daily dungeon time til reset text added
[/list]

Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed rave cave chamber blocking exit
[*] Fixed developer chamber blocking exit
[*] Fixed Helga losing health gained during war cry

[/list]

notes.title: Dungeon League Release Date
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9499154/3b215de48c219513516b0683f3782bcff764b246.png[/img]

A horde of goblins begin drumming, steadily building to an ear shattering crescendo. Minotaurs escape their pens and begin stampeding. 72 banshees squeal like adolescent school girls at a Beatles concert. A lone troll weeps a single tear while softly soiling himself. 


 It’s finally here,

The Dungeon League.

November 1st 2018


It has been one hell of a journey dungeoneers but it is finally here!!! Thank you so much to everyone that has supported us through the early access period, you have all been absolutely invaluable in support and feedback, we really could not have done it without you. We are so excited to show you everything we have worked on and hope you will enjoy all the love we have poured into getting this game across the finish line. This release version of Dungeon League is a MASSIVE update to the version currently online. We are happy to unveil,

[list]
[*]Online Multiplayer!!!
[*]Matchmaking with random opponents or Private Lobby with friends.
[*]A New Hero: Rumteeth the Skeleton Pirate (yar)
[*]A Daily Dungeon with leaderboard
[*]Leaderboards for 1, 2, 3, 4 player Gauntlet runs
[*]Unlockable Trinkets: Cursors, Emotes, Gravestone
[*]Emotes: Let your opponents know how you feel!
[*]40+ All new items with a wide variety of game changing effects
[*]New monsters: Death knight, Magus, Banshee
[*]Chambers: Exciting and hard obstacle rooms found in Gauntlet
[*]Polish, Polish, Polish: It feels tighter, It looks better, It sounds crunchier
[/list]

Expect to hear more from us as the final date draws closer!  
Ok, you can stop drumming now goblins. Goblins… please…


Grotesquely,
Dungeon Master

notes.title: Patch 1.8 Lady Meow Now Live!
notes.content:
Greetings all stars

Some of you got to try out this patch at the recent Pax Aus convention and we are now happy to push it live!

First key feature is the new All Star! Lady Meow has entered the Dungeon League. She slices she dices, she kills all the mices... Or something like that. She is fast, has a deadly returning fan and can grappling hook away in a moments notice. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9499154/ee4b3d86eb991f3afbd2958f98ccb8666fbee89a.gif[/img]

Something horrible has been growing in the dark... monster champions can now be found in the dungeon. These baddies have boosted stats and random abilities. To celebrate their release we have added a new quest mode, Slayer, where the team to kill the most Champions will claim the round!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9499154/406bd9a9fc8f5b201cb0cff59426578e54d8e7db.png[/img]

Gauntlet has undergone a significant transformation where it is now infinite! Grab your friends and see how far you can make it down. We have even added a new score system so you can compare how well you are doing to others. Be sure to post screen captures of your best effort!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9499154/5c1555180507944523f100bad2b65ca6c737097d.png[/img]

The full patch notes are contained below, and as always be sure to leave us any feedback in the comments below or in the discussion topic on the forums.

Happy Dungeoning!
Christopher 


[h1]Patch Notes 1.8[/h1]
[list]
[h1]New All Star![/h1]
[*]Lady Meow has entered the Dungeon League
[*]Fast melee character
[*]Nine Lives - evade incoming damage
[*]Pounce - A deadly dash that bounces between enemies
[*]Death Fan - Throw a deadly fan that returns to you
[*]Kitty Hook - Shoot out a grappling hook and damage enemies as you travel

[h1]Champions![/h1]
[*]Deadly monster champions have entered the Dungeon League
[*]These nasty creepers have buffed stats and random abilities

[h1]New Quest - Slayer[/h1]
[*]Be the team to kill the most Monster Champions 

[h1]Gauntlet[/h1]
[*]Gauntlet is now infinite!
[*]A score system has now been added
[*]A breakdown of your score is shown in the Post death screen

[h1]All Stars[/h1]
[*]Extra armour given to all melee characters (Reginald, Cosmos, Helga)
[*]All Abilities have been stripped of item buffs (except Recharge)
[*]Abilities are no longer base stat dependant, they rely entirely on ranks

[h1]Albert[/h1]
[*]Horn Beam now converts minions permanently, ranks increase the number you can control and the stat boost they receive.

[h1]Cosmos[/h1]
[*]Holy Hammer damage reduced but hammers now daze targets

[h1]Items[/h1]
[*]Damage bonuses have been removed from most items

[h1]Damage Text[/h1]
[*]Damage text has been removed in order to clean up the screen chaos a bit. This will become an option in the finished product.

[h1]Bugs[/h1]
[*]Fixed bug where stats were not showing correctly in Dugout
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Update 1.7.2
notes.content:
Greetings Dungeoneers,

We are busy working away on a huge patch for Pax Aus but felt we needed to push a minor update to get rid of some nasty bugs, especially the annoying flickering tiles that has been occurring for windows users.

- Fixed bug that would cause dungeon tiles to flicker on windows
- Fixed bug where items would not equip
- Reduced Gasket turret duration (20) and made level dependant 6/8/10/12
- Reduced range of Drake's firewall so you can position it more accurately 

Happy dungeoning!
Christopher

notes.title: Update 1.7 Is Live - Welcome Helga to the Dungeon!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9499154/ef9bd22eabe9dcc0dc2c3c168b345a1d3e046d55.gif[/img]

Greetings All Stars,

It's been a while since we released a Dungeon League update - as we move closer to launch we decided that to make Dunegon League the best it can be, we really needed to implement some form of Online Multiplayer. So as a result, a complete code overhaul was needed, which essentially pushed us back to the the start of the project again. I'm happy to report that the development is now back on track, and as a result, let this be the unofficial announcement that Online Multiplayer is on its way! But enough about that, let's take a look at the newest update!

Meet Helga, the angriest All Star to enter the Dungeon league. This Barbarian would even give Conan a run for his money in an arm wrestle! Inspire your team mates with her War Cry, or decimate the enemy in a Whirlwind of axes! She's brutal on the field, and if she gets too close, she will crush you like a worm. Hot tip for ranged players, keep Helga at bay at all costs. Distance is the key!

Achebit has also thrown in a number of bug fixes and balance changes to the existing characters, a couple of new monsters, and some brand new items for you to explore. So grab some controllers, get your friends over, and check out the latest additions to the game!

Christopher and Ed have taken the time to record a video outlining the features of the new patch and talk strategy and builds surrounding Helga. Please check out the video below!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ehQ8sjdm-HI

[b]Steve - Community Manager[/b]


[h1]Dungeon League Update 1.7 Patch Notes[/h1]

[h1]Characters[/h1]

[h1]Helga[/h1]
[list]
[*]New All Star! Helga the Barbarian has entered the Dungeon League
[/list]

[h1]Cosmos[/h1]
[list]
[*]Wrath now travels faster
[/list]

[h1]Drake[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where Firewall would not spawn correctly 
[*]Drastically increased Firewall duration to 6/8/10/12 from 3/3.5/4/4.5
[/list]

[h1]Albert[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where Friendzone would not refresh the control timer of monsters you already control
[*]Fixed a bug where Bubble deflections would not award you the kill
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]

[h1]Local Lobby[/h1]
[list]
[*]A new screen for organising players and teams has been added
[*]All Star selection is now structured via a randomised order with turn based picks
[*]Randomly picking an All Star (Press Y) now has a scrolling effect
[/list]

[h1]Dungeon[/h1]
[list]
[*]Spear Traps now have sounds when they extend and retract
[*]Less torches spawn in rooms that have lit objectives
[*]Less torches spawn overall (darker dungeons mwuhahaha)
[*]Items and gold drop more often (you’re welcome)
[/list]

[h1]Monsters[/h1]
[list]
[*]New Monster! Rat
[*]New Monster! Zombie
[/list]

[h1]Dugout[/h1]
[list]
[*]A 60 second timer has been added to the Dugout screen
[/list]

[h1]Shop[/h1]
[list]
[*]Bribe price decreased to 2 gold and increases by 2 with each use
[*]Shop now only sells tier 3 items after the second round
[/list]

[h1]Mechanics[/h1]
[list]
[*]Damage, Armour and Health have been globally scaled for more control
[*]Lifesteal has been added. Gain a percent of your damage back as health!
[*]Respawn time in CTF reduced by 1 second
[/list]

[h1]Items[/h1]
[list]
[*]New Item! Blood Stone: Lifesteal 3%
[*]New Item! Vampiric Cloak: Lifesteal 6%
[*]New Item! Hunger: Lifesteal 9%
[*]New Item! Kite Shield: +Block +Armour +Health
[*]Items have globally had their price reduced
[*]Many items now confer more than one bonus
[*]Short Sword re-added
[*]Skull Cap re-added
[/list]

[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*]Splash screen added
[*]Keyboard controls now default to player 4
[*]Doors and Chest will now become bright when focused
[/list]

[h1]Bugs[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed layering issues on various objects
[*]Fixed bug where health, damage, and armour items were not working correctly
[*]Fixed bug where a players correct stats would not be shown in their player card
[/list]

notes.title: 1.6 - Lair of the Goblin King Update - Gauntlet Mode Now Available
notes.content:
Hello Dungeon Competitors!

The first Dungeon League update for 2016 is here,

Gauntlet mode is finally here, and it will test the best of the best. It's kinda like Top Gun, but with way more goblins. This brand new mode is a 1-4 player co-op Roguelike that plays more like a traditional dungeon crawler. While the competitive multiplayer of Dungeon League has always been the focus, creating a fun single-player or co-op experience seemed like a great way to make sure that anyone can enjoy the game, no matter what their favourite game modes are.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/zTM2sXH.gif[/img]

So the first iteration only includes one dungeon, Lair of the Goblin King. Your party will need to make your way through a series of enemies, some familiar, others completely new. If you make it to the end, you'll have to face off against the horrendous Goblin King, who can call in swarms of minions with his trusty horn. Be careful, he has a habit of farting poisonous gasses which will hinder our heroes, or perhaps even cause death.

Among the new enemies are the Troll, who regenerates his health which is particularly annoying considering he is quite a beefy enemy. There's also a Goblin Shaman who will be spewing spells left, right and centre, and make sure you watch out for the Goblin Boomer who will be chasing you with his exploding bombs!

There have also been a healthy amount of tweaks and bug fixes behind the scenes as we ramp up development towards the online multiplayer modes. As always we appreciate all the feedback, so if you have suggestions or find some bugs, please throw them into the Lair of the Goblin King thread.

The update took a little longer than expected, mainly due to the fact that we needed to recode the entire backend from scratch as we moved to a new version of Unity. Many sleepless nights and hundreds of squashed bugs later, we are happy to unleash this new update for you all! 

Until next time!

Steve [b]- Community Manager[/b]

[h1]Dungeon League v 1.6.0 - Lair of the Goblin King Patch Notes[/h1]

[h1]Gauntlet Mode[/h1]
[list]
  [*] 1-4 players can now co-op their way through a procedural dungeon!
[/list]

[h1]Dungeons[/h1]
[list]
  [*] Dungeon sections now have unique roll charts for monsters and traps
  [*] New dungeon section! Caves
  [*] New dungeon section! Mines
  [*] New dungeon section! Treasury
[/list]

[h1]Monsters[/h1]
[list]
  [*] New boss! The Goblin King
  [*] New monster! Goblin Shaman
  [*] New monster! Goblin Boomer
  [*] New monster! Troll
  [*] New monster! Bat
  [*] Goblins now have 4 sub types (Goblin, Imp, Kobold, Gremlin)
  [*] General balancing across existing monsters
[/list]

[h1]All Stars[/h1]
[list]
  [*] Reginald: Attack speed slowed from 0.4 to 0.45
  [*] Reginald Bash: Max stun reduced, Stun scales better in lower levels
  [*] Luna: Attack speed increased from 0.3 to 0.25
  [*] Albert: Move speed increased by 1
  [*] Cosmos Wrath: Damage increased, Stun scales better in lower levels
  [*] Gasket Tickin' Chkicken: Damage reduced, Stun scales better in lower levels
  [*] Drake Phoenix: Now cleanses Drake of all debuffs

notes.title: 1.6 - Lair of the Goblin King Update - Gauntlet Mode Now Available
notes.content:
Hello Dungeon Competitors!

The first Dungeon League update for 2016 is here,

Gauntlet mode is finally here, and it will test the best of the best. It's kinda like Top Gun, but with way more goblins. This brand new mode is a 1-4 player co-op Roguelike that plays more like a traditional dungeon crawler. While the competitive multiplayer of Dungeon League has always been the focus, creating a fun single-player or co-op experience seemed like a great way to make sure that anyone can enjoy the game, no matter what their favourite game modes are.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/zTM2sXH.gif[/img]

So the first iteration only includes one dungeon, Lair of the Goblin King. Your party will need to make your way through a series of enemies, some familiar, others completely new. If you make it to the end, you'll have to face off against the horrendous Goblin King, who can call in swarms of minions with his trusty horn. Be careful, he has a habit of farting poisonous gasses which will hinder our heroes, or perhaps even cause death.

Among the new enemies are the Troll, who regenerates his health which is particularly annoying considering he is quite a beefy enemy. There's also a Goblin Shaman who will be spewing spells left, right and centre, and make sure you watch out for the Goblin Boomer who will be chasing you with his exploding bombs!

There have also been a healthy amount of tweaks and bug fixes behind the scenes as we ramp up development towards the online multiplayer modes. As always we appreciate all the feedback, so if you have suggestions or find some bugs, please throw them into the Lair of the Goblin King thread.

The update took a little longer than expected, mainly due to the fact that we needed to recode the entire backend from scratch as we moved to a new version of Unity. Many sleepless nights and hundreds of squashed bugs later, we are happy to unleash this new update for you all! 

Until next time!

notes.title: I Will Survive - Beta 1.3 Update Now Live!
notes.content:
[img]http://dungeonleaguegame.com/wp-content/themes/dlg/library/images/logo.png[/img]

Greetings Champions! 

The first major update for Dungeon League is now live! The I Will Survive update adds a new mode, and entirely new leveling system, and many tweaks and adjustments. 

We dived into the specifics of the update in a community post which can be found here: http://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791439020562/announcements/detail/61151526968719478

We have also created a discussion specifically for feedback based on this update. Please jump in here and let know what you think: http://steamcommunity.com/app/362310/discussions/0/517141807565670631/

Below you will find the patch notes. Good luck competitors! 

Steve - Community Manager

-------------

[h1]Beta 1.3: I Will Survive[/h1]

[h1]Survival Mode[/h1]
[list]
[*] Survival mode has been added! 1-4 players attempt to survive for as many waves as possible!
[/list]

[h1]New Leveling System[/h1]
[list]
[*] XP screen has been scrapped. leveling is now dynamic, players earn XP and level while in game. Leveling up will also refill your Hp and Mp to full.
[*] In game float text signifies XP gained
[*] The player id number has been swapped out to instead show the players current level
[*] The Skill Trainer is now only visited once before the match begins to create and select a skill path
[*] The Shop is now only visited once pre-match to create and select an item loadout
[/list]

[h1]Control Pad[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added D Pad support
[/list]

[h1]Keyboard[/h1]
[list]
[*] Overall responsiveness improved
[*] Fixed diagonal speed increase 
[/list]

[h1]Cosmos[/h1]
[list]
[*] Healing light now debuffs self and allies (fire, poison, cold, and silence begone!)
[/list]

[h1]Albert[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed Hornbeam to no longer silence players
[*] Hornbeam no longer converts Player Minions (such as Drake’s golem)
[*] Fairy is now faster and damage increased to 4/8/12 from 4/6/8
[*] Rainbow Dash damage increased to 4/7/10 from 3/5/7
[/list]

[h1]Gasket[/h1]
[list]
[*] Radius on Bombs and Ticking Chicken increased to 32 from 24
[*] Bomb damage up
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*] A quest HUD has been added to the top left to remind players of their current quest
[*] Many GUIi text’s now pulse when they change
[*] Selection screen now starts each player on a random All Star
[*] Holding the witches eye now drains your life 10% every time it ticks over to score
[*] Witches eye and Obelisk score text changed from “+1” to “+1 Score” for clarity
[*] Max Fire Stack reduced to 6 from 8
[*] Max poison stack reduced to 6 from 8
[/list]

[h1]Monsters[/h1]
[list]
[*] Overall monster difficulty lowered through various hp and damage adjustments
[*] Each dungeon level will now only spawn two types of monsters
[*] Monster drop rates now scale with the number of players
[*] Quantity of monsters now scales with the number of players
[*] Evil Eye laser slowed by 16%
[/list]

[h1]Bugs[/h1]
[list]
[*] Sentry Turrets no longer fire once the round ends
[*] Monsters no longer take damage once the round ends
[/list]

notes.title: Major Update Coming This Week!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/J3p1Hyb.png[/img]


[b]Greetings Champions[/b]

The first update for Dungeon League will be hitting your Steam libraries this Friday! After an insane showing at PAX Prime (thanks to everyone who stopped by the booth!), we wanted to give you a heads up on what the update will contain, and why we made some of the changes that you will find. 

[h1]Survival Mode[/h1]

The first iteration of Survival Mode will be launching, supporting 1-4 players. Competitors will face off against endless waves of Monsters, attempting to last the longest and be crowned the ultimate Dungeon League survivor. We're looking forward to gathering your feedback on the first pass at the new game mode, and together we'll really make this a challenge for the ages! 

[h1]Goodbye XP Screens, Hello Builds![/h1]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/eDnhy9V.png[/img]

After watching people play the game, and taking feedback from the Steam Community Hub, we quickly realised that having players assign XP to certain skills and upgrades was a bit of a chore. Players love Dungeon League because the game is fast and frenetic, so we have decided to scrap the in-between rounds skill screen in favour of auto-leveling! When starting a game, players will choose a "build" for their character, and the game will automatically assign and unlock the next skills during the action. Every time you level up, you MP and HP will be fully replenished, which also creates some interesting swings in the heat of competition. We tested the new feature at PAX Prime, and seeing the pace of the game change so dynamically was amazing. We can't wait to get your feedback on this new change once you start playing the game at home - so please keep giving us your feedback once the update drops later this week. 

[h1]Character and Monster Balance[/h1]

Once again, this comes directly from your player feedback. We've tweaked each individual hero and made some changes to their abilities to help balance the game. On Friday we'll give you the complete rundown, but Albert is getting the brunt of the changes in order to balance him out against the others. We've also lowered the difficulty of the monsters to make them a little less punishing, and they will now scale accordingly to the number of players competing. 

There's a tonne of other new bits and bobs in Friday's update, but we hope this short glimpse will pump you up and get ready to enter the dungeon this Friday! 
 
[b]Steve - Community Manager[/b]

notes.title: Dark Flock - Update 1.2 now live!
notes.content:
Hello heroes!

Another great week of awesome community members for Dungeon League. We've enjoyed reading your comments, watching Let's Plays and streams, and we can't wait to see the game grow.

AcheBit has pushed out another minor update that fixes some issues, balances some heroes, and other various updates. The patch notes are below as always.

Stay tuned for some more info about our first major update in the coming weeks!

Steve - Community Manager.

[h1]Dungeon League Early Access 1.2 - Dark Flock Update[/h1]

[h1]Keyboard[/h1]

[list]
[*]Keyboard now controls player 4 by default so you can play multiplayer with only one controller[/list]

[h1]Cosmos[/h1]
[list]
[*]Holy hammers now deflect ranged attacks[/list]

[h1]Luna[/h1]
[list]
[*]Evade has been replaced with Shadow Meld, dash a short distance followed by a period of concealment. Duration based on skill rank.
[*]Shadow Form replaced with Dark Flock, silence and knock back enemies, also quells nearby torches
[*]Arrow storm no longer stacks with Frost Arrows, it instead inflicts additional burning damage with each arrow[/list]

[h1]Albert[/h1]
[list]
[*]Hornbeam has entirely new functionality. Hornbeam now converts nearby monsters to Alberts team for a short duration. Go make make some new friends![/list]

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*]Race flags are now coloured red, green, blue to help with order
[*]Knockback tweaked for many entities
[*]Max fire stacking lowered to 8 from 10
[*]Max poison stacking lowered to 8 from 10
[*]Minotaur stun chance lowered to 30% from 40%
[/list]

[h1]Skills[/h1]
[list]
[*]Skill Titles coloured according to rank (green - blue - purple - red)
[*]Skill descriptions now shown in green for passive and orange for active
[*]Skill descriptions reduced in length and text made larger for readability
[*]Health skill buffed to +4Hp per rank from +3Hp
[*]Mana skill buffed to +6Mp per rank from +3Mp
[/list]

[h1]Items[/h1]
[list]
[*]Info text on various items corrected and shortened
[*]Ring of Haste fixed to correct cooldown of 12 seconds from 0 seconds
[*]Wizard Staff buffed to +10Mp from +6Mp
[*]6 second trigger cooldown added to Storm Helm
